info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to act, to become, to arrange, to try, to make an effort

examples: 'ko vA viSvajanInezu karmasu prAGawizyata' (Bawwi॰21.17). sarvAtmanA'yatizyata udayokzyata udayaMsyata.
'sAndraM leQi rasAmftaM vicinute tAtparyamudrAM ca yaH. saNGawate… kAvyaSramajYo janaH' (kA॰mI॰1.4).. saNGawate=yujyate.
'ete drAgeva viGawizyante.' BedaM prApsyanti palAyizyanta iti vA.
'tato vijaGawe SElEH' (Bawwi0 14.66). viGawitam. SElA BedamApuH, saMhatiM jahurityarTaH.
'kAryamudGAwitaM kvApi maDye viGawate yataH' (hitopa0 4.2). viGawate=pratihanyate virAmameti.
'mantriRA pfTivIpAlacittaM viGawitaM yadi. valayaM sPawikasyeva ko nu sanDAtumarhati' (hitopa0 2.157).. viGawitaM dviDA Binnam.
'dahAmyahaM yuzmAnsadasyudGAwayAmi vA' (kaTA0 4.78).  udGAwayAmi rahasyaM vo vivfRomi. rahasyaM Binadmi. guhyaM sUcayAmi.
'viwajanapariGAwiteva vIRA' (mfcCa0 ) pariGAwitA spfzwA, AmfzwA, AhatA. viwajananaKaGawwiteti pAWAntaram.
